headline: Exchange Inflows Rose To 861.1 Million Dollars As Binance Took In 685.2 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 861.1 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.3163 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, up from 282.8 million dollars and 0.1042 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell, and the larger print means that arrival sped up. Binance took in 685.2 million dollars and Bitstamp took in 420.2 million, while Bitfinex shed 231.1 million and OKX shed 152.8 million.
author: jordan
